title: Navigating the Rabbit Hole: Emergent Biases in LLM-Generated Attack Narratives Targeting Mental Health Groups

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzes iterative, toxic language generation chains (Toxicity Rabbit Hole framework) by extracting victim entities and building a directed network to measure centrality and community clustering of mental health targets. It also uses LLM-based annotation to compare the severity of stigmatization components (labeling, negative stereotyping, separation, and status loss) between initial prompt targets and emergent mental health entities.
